prompts.documentation:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a refined original 1960s Andy Warhol-influenced silkscreen cutout for a technical website, not a stock software icon. Large flat spot-color shapes, elegant editorial composition, crisp ink contours and restrained print texture. Use only five coordinated inks: deep forest #153C2B, jade #45BD8B, coral #F17E8C, ultramarine-violet #6861D8, golden yellow #F1C861. Broad bright planes must read on both white and near-black green pages. Wide horizontal 3:2 canvas, 1536x1024, with a coherent sculptural collage occupying most of the canvas and 8% clear breathing room. Genuinely transparent PNG with alpha-zero background and transparent gaps; deliberate printed shapes are opaque. No background rectangle, checkerboard, writing, letters, numbers, logos, captions, gradients, glow, cast shadows, photographic light, 3D, tiny interface icons or stock corporate cartoons. This is decorative art, not an architectural diagram.
Subject: a monumental open illustrated reference book seen in three-quarter view, layered jade and golden pages fanning gracefully across a coral cloth binding, a finely drawn hand turning one large page, and a violet ribbon bookmark looping through the composition. A few generous blank graphic panels and simple broad line motifs on the pages evoke instructions without any text. One angular inset fold-out sheet gives rhythm. Thoughtful printmaking and publishing, not portraits, theatre, telephones or computer hardware. An art-school paper composition with bold clean silhouettes.

prompts.collaboration:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a large, wide editorial illustration for the ctlflow website hero about people working with their own agent fleets in Matrix rooms.
Create an original refined 1960s pop-art silkscreen composition with a strong Andy Warhol influence: repetition, bold flat spot-colour separations, elegant print registration, sophisticated magazine-cover draughtsmanship, not a cartoon mascot.
Subject: three overlapping large cameo portraits in profile, one recognizably human, one abstract geometric agent face, and another human, turned toward each other in conversation. Repeat one profile as a slightly offset coloured silhouette. Interlock two generous blank speech shapes with the portraits to suggest exchanging messages. No writing, no logos.
Composition: a single coherent horizontal cutout, approximately 3:2 canvas, subject occupies 85% of the width and 75% of the height, generous transparent negative space around and between the forms. Strong readable silhouettes; balanced open composition, not a rigid four-panel grid.
Palette: exactly five flat inks: deep forest green #153C2B, vivid jade #45BD8B, warm coral #F17E8C, saturated ultramarine-violet #6861D8, golden yellow #F1C861. Use coral, jade and gold for large luminous planes and dark green only for elegant facial details. Colours should pop on both pure white and very dark green pages.
Genuinely transparent PNG background, including the gaps between shapes. No opaque backdrop, no white rectangle, no printed checkerboard, no cast shadow or ground plane. No gradients, photographic shading, 3D, fine grain, tiny dots, textures, circuit boards, generic friendly robots, lettering, frames or slogans. The result is tasteful flat-colour print artwork, not an infographic or UI screenshot.
prompts.crossfire:
Use case: stylized-concept. A refined original 1960s pop-art screen-print cutout for the crossfire landing page, about connecting people and agent fleets and routing conversations. Strong Andy Warhol influence: repeated everyday communication objects, sophisticated flat colour separations, confident editorial composition.
Subject: a sweeping collage of three handsome vintage telephone handsets and an exchange operator's poised hand, connected by elegant looping cords to three small profile cameos. The repeated receiver silhouette changes colour, while the cords visibly tie the groups together. No screens, tech clip art, robots, text or numbers.
Make a wide, large 3:2 composition that feels like a collectible art print, with clear transparent gaps between objects and a quiet 8–10% outer margin. Restrict to five flat inks: forest #153C2B, jade #45BD8B, coral #F17E8C, ultramarine-violet #6861D8, gold #F1C861. Vivid luminous large shapes, elegant dark detail, strong on white or dark forest backgrounds.
Genuinely transparent PNG, cut out around the whole composition and through open loops. Solid opaque colour within shapes. No paper, rectangle, matte, background scene, photographic shading, 3D, gradients, glow, haze, shadows, checkerboard, logos, writing or decorative frames. Large clear silhouettes with refined linework rather than tiny detail.
prompts.fleetd:

Two busts are human, two have abstract geometric masks suggesting agents rather than cute robots. The repetition and colour changes should evoke a Warhol silkscreen edition; the conductor's gesture brings the portraits into a graceful rhythm. Artistic metaphor, not a technical diagram.
Wide horizontal 3:2 canvas, a single composed sculpture-like collage with true transparent negative spaces and an outer 8% transparent margin. Sophisticated editorial draughtsmanship, large flat shapes, lively asymmetry and crisp ink contours. Five spot inks only: deep forest #153C2B, jade #45BD8B, coral #F17E8C, ultramarine-violet #6861D8 and golden yellow #F1C861. Bright broad planes remain legible on white and near-black green.
Transparent PNG with fully clear background and opaque printed shapes. No background rectangle, text, musical notation, labels, logos, glow, cast shadow, gradients, paper grain, photographic shading, 3D, tiny decorative dots, interface widgets or checkerboard. Refined artwork, not an icon set or stock business cartoon.

prompts.theatre:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a large wide editorial pop-art illustration for a London theatre example fleet called fleet-street. Original refined 1960s Andy Warhol-influenced silkscreen print, bold flat spot-colour planes, elegant art-school poster composition, strong repeated silhouettes and crisp negative space.
Subject: a handsome London West End Victorian theatre proscenium with ornate curved balcony rails and sweeping open coral curtains; a large expressive comedy-mask profile and a thoughtful actor portrait repeated in jade and violet; a small ticket-stub shape and hard-edged gold spotlight wedges complete the theatrical collage. It should unmistakably evoke the London stage and theatre production, not a cinema, music concert or computer scene. No real venue brand or celebrity.
One coherent balanced horizontal cutout on a 3:2 canvas, large subjects with 10% clear breathing room around the outside. Transparent gaps and open arches; no rectangular poster background. Restrict the entire image to FIVE flat inks: deep forest #153C2B, jade #45BD8B, warm coral #F17E8C, ultramarine-violet #6861D8 and golden yellow #F1C861. Broad luminous planes must read beautifully on both white and near-black green pages.
Output genuinely transparent PNG. Clear unpainted areas are alpha zero. Printed shapes are solid colour, not translucent. No writing, lettering, labels, logos, slogans, photographic rendering, 3D, gradients, paper backdrop, cast shadows, glows, soft-focus haze or checkerboard. Sophisticated collectible theatre screen-print artwork, not a cartoon or diagram.
prompts.toolsmith:

Subject: a sculptural composition of a handsome open tool case holding a large pair of scissors, a compass, a spanner and neatly layered coloured sheets. Repeat the scissors silhouette once in another ink, with a finely drawn craftsman's hand carefully placing a cut paper shape. This is about a practical set of tools that can be combined, not a software dashboard. Sophisticated artist's workshop meets pop-art studio.
One large balanced horizontal 3:2 cutout, with transparent space visible between handles, tools and layered shapes and around the entire group. Confident flat planes, clean silhouettes and restrained elegant screen-print detail. Use only five inks shared by the series: forest #153C2B, jade #45BD8B, coral #F17E8C, ultramarine-violet #6861D8, golden yellow #F1C861. Keep generous bright gold/coral/jade planes so the art works on white and dark green backgrounds.
Deliver a genuinely transparent PNG. No paper background, rectangle, drop shadow, 3D, photographic light, gradients, glow, fog, checkerboard, writing, logos, labels or numbers. No stock corporate illustration, tiny icons or mascots. All deliberate shapes are opaque; all negative space is clear.
prompts.collaborationRefinement: Edit this illustration to be a CLEAN FLAT SILKSCREEN CUTOUT. Keep the three portraits, their positions, the speech shapes and the five ink colours exactly. Remove ALL the blurred colour clouds, glow, shadow, haze, vignette and soft aura around and between them. Remove every colour outside the hard-edged silhouettes. The negative space must be actually fully transparent alpha=0, not black or white. Inside each silhouette use solid opaque flat colour fills, no gradients or lighting, no translucent colour clouds. Use sharp cut-paper edges with only normal single-pixel antialiasing, like a crisply die-cut pop-art screen print. Preserve the subject art and composition. Transparent PNG; NO opaque backdrop or checkerboard.
